issues.oldOuter:
An elicitation should adapt to what the user is trying to achieve and how much effort they can give, instead of running through a fixed list of questions. The harness already names reusable interview situations, but it has no shared guidance for beginning an interview, proposing likely answers for correction, or deciding which uncertainties still warrant questions.

This issue will design reusable, domain-independent interviewing guidance. It includes an opening strategy that establishes the objective, its context and scope, and the user's available time, intended use, and tolerance for suggested assumptions within the first turn or two. It also covers proposing a broad draft for correction when time is short, while keeping confirmed statements, declared defaults, and unresolved suggestions visibly distinct.
issues.proposedOuter:
An elicitation should adapt to the user's objective and available effort. The harness names reusable interview situations but lacks shared guidance for opening an interview, proposing likely answers for correction, and choosing which uncertainties warrant questions.

This issue designs that guidance. The opening establishes objective, context, scope, time, intended use, and tolerance for assumptions; proposal and correction keep confirmed statements, defaults, and suggestions distinct. The scope settled on 2026-08-19, while three mechanics remain unresolved: use model-gap cues without walking the schema, distinguish session stopping from model completion, and decide whether inferred interaction preferences require stored state.
issues.innerRecord:
The kernel spec names this harness-side library the generic strategy quiver (§11.5). Guidance ownership follows vocabulary ownership: these cards teach how to work situations the shared capture envelope can name, while plugin cards teach what to notice in a domain. Plugins compose the shared cards into their packs at authoring time.

## Scope settled 2026-08-19

* Kickoff is a form the agent fills implicitly, not four literal questions. It establishes: objective; why and with respect to what; inclusion and exclusion boundaries; and the interaction posture inferred from available time, intended use, required confidence, and tolerance for agent-proposed assumptions.
* Optimize for low user effort to reach an acceptably grounded model, not for turn count. A one-turn questionnaire can score well on turns while making the experience worse.
* Strategy varies with the inferred posture: explore openly when appetite is high; synthesize and invite correction when it is constrained; propose low-risk structure and question only high-impact uncertainty in mixed cases.
* Proposal-and-correction is a generic strategy and an appetite-compensation strategy. A generated guess remains a suggestion until the user confirms or corrects it. Only declared plugin defaults may enter as `defaulted`; the IR must not present a model guess as user-grounded evidence.
* The shared capability set is: ask, propose, contrast, expose assumptions and gaps, capture corrections, and stop with visible gaps. The quiver says how to combine those capabilities. Plugins supply domain imperatives, target shapes, motifs, defaults, and the uncertainties that matter. The agent chooses among applicable strategies.
* The existing card set remains in scope: conflict, competing alternatives, ambiguity, weak or missing evidence, absence clusters, and choice-point pressure. Card form remains Detects / Goal / contrastive Questions / Artifacts unless this design pass finds that kickoff or proposal-and-correction needs a different form.

## Design seams to resolve

* The plugin contract's `firesWhen` table mechanically produces next-question candidates from model gaps. This issue must preserve those cues as candidates without turning the interview into a schema walk; kickoff also occurs before those slot-state cues exist.
* Session stopping and model completion are distinct. A constrained session may stop with a useful, structurally broad model containing confirmed proposals, declared defaults, and visible gaps.
* “Appetite” is a continuously inferred interaction posture, not necessarily a stored field or fixed user-facing mode.

## Prior design basis

The spec named but did not design the quiver, with milestone one shipping generic guidance in plugin packs. Reference shapes are ln-grill, ln-disambiguate, the `elicitation_style` trichotomy, and the assurance plugin's stress-the-argument split. [FE-1397](https://linear.app/hash/issue/FE-1397) routed recurring choice-point technique to the quiver. [FE-1403](https://linear.app/hash/issue/FE-1403) authors and tags envelope-vocabulary cards inside the CPS pack so they can graduate here.

Inputs when work starts: spec §11.5; the FE-1397 routing verdict and worked examples; FE-1403's tagged generic cards; the assurance plugin's §13.2 generic/domain decomposition; and the 2026-08-19 kickoff/appetite design discussion recorded above. Related: [FE-1357](https://linear.app/hash/issue/FE-1357), [FE-1402](https://linear.app/hash/issue/FE-1402), [FE-1403](https://linear.app/hash/issue/FE-1403), [FE-1431](https://linear.app/hash/issue/FE-1431).
